targets.title: ✦INTRADAY TRADER✦ Red days are the real test. Do you pass or panic? 👇🔥
targets.author: Intraday trader
targets.text:
Trading psychology for beginners: how to handle a red day in intraday trading, why patience through losing days builds long-term consistency, and how to stay disciplined when the market goes against you.
Every trader has red days. What separates the ones who last from the ones who quit is how they behave on those days. Panic trading, revenge trading and doubling the size to recover a loss turn one bad day into a blown account. This video is for every intraday trader who wants to stay calm, protect capital and still be around when the big days arrive.
